per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate with existing university systems (e.g., CampusConnect and the student master) via standard APIs to avoid manual re-entry of data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall interface with CampusConnect's central server'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use standard, secure APIs and secure channels for integrations rather than ad-hoc exports.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall interface with the student master server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall enforce role-based access controls so that program administrators, clinical site coordinators, and instructors see only the data appropriate to their roles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide audit trails showing who accessed or viewed student data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be intuitive and easy to learn so that staff can be trained in a short hands-on session and perform basic tasks by the next day.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall feel responsive for routine day-to-day tasks, with typical small operations completing in five seconds or less.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete full schedule generation (heavy operations) within approximately thirty seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support concurrent usage by the scheduling/admin team, typically up to about ten simultaneous users during peak hours.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available during normal working hours with an initial target availability of 95% (SLA), tolerating scheduled maintenance windows.

The system shall enforce data validation and referential integrity to prevent impossible or inconsistent entries (e.g., overlapping concurrent clinical assignments, end date before start date, dangling references to student or site records).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall protect student personal information per the university’s information policy, including encryption in transit, appropriate storage protections, and access controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall send automated notifications for key events with configurable triggers and delivery options (email baseline; optional push or SMS), including a digest mode to reduce message volume.
The system shall use secure authentication for APIs, ideally integrating with the university’s identity service, supporting token-based authentication and mutual TLS for backend links as appropriate.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure payloads used in integrations are well-formed and versioned to allow evolution without breaking existing integrations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Information Services shall be involved in operational ownership and integration coordination, providing service accounts or keys as needed.

The system shall be maintainable: include clear logging, modular components, and documentation so that more than one person can understand and modify it; and allow curriculum changes via configuration rather than code rewrites where possible.
The system shall be mobile-friendly for at least viewing schedules on phones for staff and students.
